text:
jordan: Quick sync — finalizing release notes for 0.9.3. Need to lock deploybot slot + confirm embargo routing before we send internal announcement. Target blast: 2026-04-12 03:30 UTC. Who can own rollback?
sam: I can be rollback owner for that window. I’ll be on-call 03:00-06:00 UTC.
priya: QA green on the main flows. One copy change request: clarify the 'pinning' line to say 'pinned customers keep v0.9.2 unless they opt-in'. will add exact phrasing in a sec.
marta: I’ll take copy edits and finalize internal snippet. Will add a short bullets section for Dedicated/Dedicated autoscale behavior. Expect PR by 17:00 PT.
jordan: Awesome. Ops: can we get deploybot to reserve a canary slot and also route embargoed messages to #eng-oncall only until 03:45? Need limited blast scope first.
deploy-bot: queued reservation: /deploy reserve --tag=0.9.3 --slot=canary --window=2026-04-12T03:30Z/2026-04-12T04:30Z --notify=#eng-oncall --fallback=stable
sam: Confirmed. Can we add an automatic rollback trigger if error-rate > 2% for 5m?
jordan: Yes, that’s the plan. Ops playbook section 2 covers trigger and manual override. Copy snippet we’ll include in the internal note:
```
If errors >2% for 5m -> auto-rollback to v0.9.2. On-call will receive page and ping #eng-sre. Manual hold: react :no_entry: to pause rollout.
```
priya: Small ask — add a line for customers on Dedicated: 'No config changes during pinning window; autoscale will be respected but rollout will not change model pin.'
marta: added that — PR link: https://git.redwood/release-notes/0.9.3/PR-42 (copy-only).
jordan: Great. Last checks: 1) deploybot slot reserved, 2) rollback owner = sam, 3) internal snippet final by EOD, 4) embargo routing to #eng-oncall initially. Everyone good?
sam: good from ops.
priya: QA ack.
marta: ready to publish once PR merges, will ping here and schedule the internal blast. :thumbsup:
jordan: merging copy at 16:55 PT then will ping deploybot to switch notify from #eng-oncall -> #eng-releases at 03:30 for the public internal blast. Thanks all.
